source: SINAPROC Comunicado Oficial N° 1, 9 Oct 2026 (3 pages, shared by Brenden Jongman; copies in data/official/)

reports.title: Official: partial collapse of Hotel Dos Continentes, no injuries; facades and churches damaged
reports.summary: SINAPROC confirms the partial collapse of the Hotel Dos Continentes with no injured people reported, collapsed facades on commercial premises, damage to churches and preventive evacuation of hospitals in Coclé.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: 15 students evacuated with minor injuries at Escuela Alberto Zúñiga
reports.summary: Fifteen students of the Escuela Alberto Zúñiga in Coclé were evacuated with minor injuries (school location approximate).
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: one person rescued at Aguadulce municipal market
reports.summary: One person was rescued at the municipal market in Aguadulce.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: road infrastructure affected in Coclé
reports.summary: SINAPROC reports damage to road infrastructure in Coclé.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: homes collapsed and religious and government buildings damaged in Los Santos
reports.summary: SINAPROC reports collapsed homes, damage to religious and government buildings and to road infrastructure, and structural damage to two barracks (Fire Brigade and National Police) in Los Santos province.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: minor damage at Tonosí hospital
reports.summary: SINAPROC reports minor damage at the hospital in Tonosí.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: minor damage at Pedasí hospital
reports.summary: SINAPROC reports minor damage at the hospital in Pedasí.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: increased wave activity reported at Isla Cañas
reports.summary: SINAPROC reports increased wave activity (oleaje) at Isla Cañas after the earthquake.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: considerable cracks at Macaracas and La Villa fire stations
reports.summary: The Fire Brigade reports considerable structural cracking at its La Villa de Los Santos and Macaracas stations.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: Soná fire station largely collapsed, trapping emergency vehicles
reports.summary: The Fire Brigade reports that much of the Soná station collapsed, trapping emergency vehicles and a rescue boat (zodiac).
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: slab detachment and structural cracks at Santiago fire station 1
reports.summary: The Fire Brigade reports slab detachment and structural cracking at Station 1 in Santiago.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: ceiling detachment at Coclé central fire station
reports.summary: The Fire Brigade reports damage and ceiling detachment at Station 1 (central) in Coclé.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: minor damage at Herrera fire stations
reports.summary: The Fire Brigade reports minor damage in Herrera: fallen ceilings and lifted floor tiles.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: slab detachment and cracks at La Chorrera and Veracruz fire stations
reports.summary: The Fire Brigade reports slab detachment and a crack in the officers' room at the La Chorrera station, and a crack at the Veracruz station.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: cracks in the structure of David central fire station
reports.summary: The Fire Brigade reports cracks in the structure of central Station 1 in David; other stations are being assessed.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: damage to shops and homes in the Pearl Islands
reports.summary: SINAPROC reports damage to businesses and homes in the Archipiélago de las Perlas.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: minor damage in four high-rise condominium buildings in Panama
reports.summary: SINAPROC reports minor infrastructure damage in four horizontal-property (PH) buildings, preventive evacuation of hospitals and health centres, and continuous sea-level monitoring in Panamá province.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: minor damage at Centro Educativo de Zapayal, Darién
reports.summary: SINAPROC reports minor damage to the infrastructure of the Centro Educativo de Zapayal in Darién (location approximate).
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: light damage to homes and businesses in Chiriquí; schools affected
reports.summary: SINAPROC reports light damage to homes and some businesses in Chiriquí. MEDUCA lists schools with preliminary damage reports, including in David, Barú (Progreso, Paso Canoas), Remedios, Bugaba, Gualaca, Boquerón and San Félix.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1

reports.title: Official: water treatment plants damaged nationwide; Chilibre at 20%
reports.summary: IDAAN reports damage to the infrastructure of almost all water treatment plants nationwide; the Chilibre plant in the capital is operating at 20% of capacity.
reports.source_name: SINAPROC / Ministerio de Gobierno — Comunicado Oficial N° 1
